g.data-description: the 20 CSFP/SFP cages in two ganged 2-row blocks (six columns, then four). Each cage takes a dual-port CSFP (two interfaces) or a single-port SFP (the odd interface only): column k has ports 4k-3 and 4k-2 in its top cage and 4k-1 and 4k in its bottom cage, 40 ports in all (MDAE Table 10 keys 3-4, section 4.2.1). Each cage declares its two ports as `interfaces:`, the pair its id names.
